If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  OF THE MAY 11, 2021
  SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City Council meeting via Zoom pursuant to
Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 26, 2020, was called to order
by Mayor Kemps at 4:00 P.M. on May 11, 2021 , notice having been given with affidavit thereto on file.
Members of the public were provided with the following information to provide public input:

  BY COMPUTER:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84237549414
  Zoom Meeting ID: 842 3754 9414 or
  BY TELEPHONE: 1669900 9128, Enter Code 842 3754 9414#
  BY EMAIL: CityCouncilMeeting@pvestates.org

  CALL TO ORDER 4:00 p.m.
  ROLL CALL

  PRESENT: Mayor Kemps, Mayor Pro Tern Lozzi, Councilmembers McGowan, Roos and
  Murdock

  ALSO PRESENT:
  City Manager Guglielmo, City Attorney Cotti, Treasurer Greenberg, Police Chief Best,
  Community Development Director Rindge, City Support Services Director Hannah, City Clerk
  Chaney, Finance Advisory Committee Members Forte, Young, DeHoff, Haji and Nendick.

  COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council.

  NEW BUSINESS

  1. Presentation and Consideration of the City Manager's Proposed Budget for Fiscal
  Year 2021/22 and Direction to the City Manager as Deemed Appropriate

  City Manager Guglielmo and City Support Services Director Hannah presented the draft
  budget.

  The City Councilmembers and Members of the Finance Advisory Committee provided
  feedback in a number of areas, including the following: clarification of the intent of the
  City's Emergency Reserve with a desire to update the Reserve Policy to insure the Policy
  clearly reflects the intent of the City Council; include comparisons of revenues and
  expenses with FY 20/21 Adopted Budget; importance of a structurally balanced budget,
  include overall assumptions/bases used during the crafting of the Proposed Budget; provide
  additional "business case" for the ERP Replacement project, including prioritizing the use
  of special revenues as the ERP Replacement may qualify as a capital expenditure (for
  example, the Equipment Replacement Fund or ARPA funds); additional detail on the
  differences ofFTEs and related salary/benefit costs; additional review of the overtime costs
  in the Police Department; provide additional "business case" for the proposed upgrade of
   the part-time Permit Technician position; proposal to consider additional code enforcement
  services (via staff or contract).

  City Councilmember(s) also expressed interest in a discussion of unmet needs and a policy
  related to how the City will address the pension debt.

ADJOURNMENT

The City Council noted the next special meeting to review the draft budget would be May 25th at 4:00
p.m. There being no further business before the City Council, the meeting was adjourned at 6:26 p.m.

RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

Kyly

  APPROVED:

  Michael Kemps, Mayor
